text: {"rules":[{"id":"DEPRESSION-SCREEN-ADULT","version":"June 2023","title":"Depression screening in adults, including pregnant and postpartum persons and older adults","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for depression in the adult population, including pregnant and postpartum persons, as well as older adults.","grade":"B","effective_date":"June 2023","action":"Screen adults for depression, including pregnant and postpartum persons and older adults.","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adult population\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"'adult' is taken to mean age 18 or older; the number 18 is not stated in the section text\"}}","numerator":"{\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"depression_screening\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"any\"}, \"quote\": \"screening for depression\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"the text gives no screening interval; an annual (measurement-year) window is assumed for checking and must be confirmed by a human reviewer\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["No screening interval is stated in the section text; the measurement-year window in the numerator is an assumption declared as derived and needs human review.","The minimum age of 18 for 'adult population' is not stated in the text and is declared as derived.","Pregnant and postpartum persons and older adults (65 years or older) are explicitly included in the adult population; no separate criteria were needed because no upper age limit is stated. Pregnant or postpartum persons younger than 18 are not addressed by this rule.","The topic title mentions suicide risk, but the section text contains no recommendation about suicide risk screening; nothing was encoded for suicide risk (the full USPSTF statement issues an I statement for it, which would not be a rule anyway).","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('June 2023 *') whose footnote is not included in the section; its meaning could not be represented.","No exclusions (e.g., existing depression diagnosis or current treatment) are stated in the text, so none were encoded.","Follow-up after a positive screen (diagnostic evaluation, treatment) is not stated in the text and is not represented."]}
